summary.text: Jason Purviance is the Libertarian candidate for the Ohio House of Representatives, District 47, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the May 5, 2026 Libertarian Party primary.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as mechanic.

paragraphs.text: Jason Purviance graduated from Lakota East High School, and Ballotpedia lists associate degrees from Cincinnati State Technical and Community College (2013) and Lincoln College of Technology in Indianapolis (2002).
His Ballotpedia survey response says he lives in Fairfield Township with his wife and son, works as an aircraft mechanic, and was recently appointed to the Fairfield Township Board of Zoning Appeals.
Purviance's survey response names protecting personal liberties, reducing state spending and taxes, and opposing government surveillance as his main campaign commitments.
